scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run check:dependency-security && npm run check:mfd-interchange && npm run check:browser-fixture && npm run check:docs-images && npm run contracts:check && npm --workspace @weft/web run check:chat-types && npm --workspace @weft/web run check && npm --workspace @weft/web run check:browser && npm run check:browser-session-probe
scripts.contracts:check: npm --prefix tools/contracts-generator run check && node tools/contracts-generator/check-specifications.mjs && npm --workspace @weft/web run check:contracts
scripts.test:browser: env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a -w 10 npm --workspace @weft/web run test:e2e
scripts.test:browser-session: env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run -a -w 10 npm --workspace @weft/web run test:e2e -- --config playwright.browser-session.config.ts
scripts.test:auth-https-browser: ulimit -c 0 && env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY xvfb-run ${WEFT_XVFB_SERVER_NUM:+--server-num=}${WEFT_XVFB_SERVER_NUM:--a} -w 10 npm --workspace @weft/web run test:e2e -- --config playwright.auth-https.config.ts
